mapper.select: SELECT addon FROM tenant_addons WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY addon
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_addons (tenant_id, addon, enabled_at, enabled_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{addon}, #{now}, #{by}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tenant_addons WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND addon = #{addon}
